## Original article text

````markdown
This event type triggers for a player when they deal knockback to another player or themself and the `Conditions` evaluate to `True`.

#### Arguments

*  [Team](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/team) - The team(s) checked by the event.
*  [Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/player) - The player(s) checked by the event based on slot number or hero.

#### Contextual Values

*  [Event Player](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+player) - The player that triggered the event.
*  [Attacker](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/attacker) - The player dealing knockback. In this context, it has the same value as `Event Player`.
*  [Victim](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/victim) - The player receiving knockback. Will have the same value as `Attacker` when dealing knockback to themself.
*  [Event Ability](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+ability) - The ability used by the `Attacker`.
*  [Event Direction](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/event+direction) - The incoming direction from the source of knockback to the `Victim`.
````
